job.job_description:
About Quantzig:

Quantzig is a global analytics and advisory firm with offices in the US, UK, Canada, China, and India. we have assisted our clients across the globe with end-to-end advanced analytics, visual storyboarding , Machine Learning and data engineering solutions implementation for prudent decision making. We are a rapidly growing organization that is built and operated by high-performance champions

If you have what it takes to be the champion with business and functional skills to take ownership of an entire project end-to-end, help build a team with great work ethic and a drive to learn, you are the one were looking for. The clients love us for our solutioning capability, our enthusiasm and we expect you to be a part of our growth story.

Company Website: https://www.quantzig.com/

GenAI – Data Science

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered applications using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Hugging Face frameworks.
Build RAG pipelines using embeddings, retrievers, and vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, or Weaviate.
Implement prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and optimisation for domain-specific use cases.
Develop and maintain Python-based microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or Streamlit for AI model integration.
Collaborate with data and frontend teams to integrate AI-powered search, summarisation, and conversational assistants into enterprise systems.
Ensure data security, scalability, and compliance in AI solutions.
Continuously explore the latest AI/ML research, tools, and frameworks to enhance solution performance.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Strong experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Hands-on expertise in RAG architectures and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Redis).
Proficiency in Python and frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Experience deploying models on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, and data integration workflows.
Knowledge of MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

GOOD TO HAVE

Experience with observability tools like MLflow, LangSmith, or Weights & Biases.
Exposure to voice-based AI assistants or AI narration systems.
Prior experience with NLP-driven applications in domains like finance, healthcare, or marketing.
Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.

WHY JOIN QUANTZIG

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Generative AI solutions and enterprise-scale deployments.
Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with an AI-first vision.
Exposure to end-to-end productisation of LLM-based systems, from prototype to production.

Location note: This is a full-time, work-from-office role based in Bangalore. Candidates should be available to work on-site.
